episodes.title: Part I
episodes.summary: Verónica and Marta's families mourn their disappearance. As the police abandon their search, Isabel manages to corner the man who last saw them.

episodes.title: Part II
episodes.summary: Isabel deals with the aftermath of her latest discovery and decides that desperate circumstances call for a dangerous alliance with Rafael.

episodes.title: Part III
episodes.summary: Antonio makes a shocking disclosure about that fateful night. As Rafael and the police draw closer to the truth, Isabel's search reaches its end.
